meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Guides a refactor, cleanup, or restructure with the right decomposition. Use when the user asks to refactor, simplify, extract, or modernize code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把混乱的代码拆解重组，理清结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果手头代码越改越乱，想在不改行为的前提下梳理结构
copy.tagline_en: Break messy code apart and rebuild it into clear structure
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase has grown messy and you want to reorganize it without changing behavior

howto.what: 装上后,输入 /refactor 并给出目标,Claude 会先确认重构意图、分析代码库与依赖关系、评估测试覆盖,再分步执行改动,每步跑测试和类型检查,最后做整体回归验证。
howto.when: 当你要求重构、简化、提取等代码改动,或输入 /refactor 并指定文件、符号、模式作为目标时触发。
howto.what_en: After install, /refactor takes a refactoring target: Claude confirms intent, maps the codebase and dependencies, checks test coverage, plans the steps, then executes changes one at a time, running tests and type checks after each step.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to refactor, simplify, or extract code, or run /refactor with a file, symbol, or pattern as the target.

say_en.note: Refactors just that file, default safe strategy.
Confirms intent before analyzing the codebase.
Wider changes; needs adequate test coverage.
